purpose: Teach: 組曲/のぞき/刺客/転居/つぐ/導か/病理/全土

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、慢性疾患の組曲、つまり一連の症状を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Ren, we analyze chronic disease patterns—the full suite of symptoms—with our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Professional tone without distance. Steady pace. The voice of someone explaining a process with care, not lecturing. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療現場でののぞき、つまりプライバシー侵害を医療チームで防ぎます
lines.en: Ren, we protect patient privacy in the medical setting—preventing any breach of confidence—as a team.
lines.style: Slightly slower delivery. Careful emphasis on 「privacy」. Steady, reassuring. The tone of someone making a serious commitment. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染症の刺客的株、つまり毒性株の研究を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we research virulent strains of infectious disease—the dangerous variants—together with our team.
lines.style: Precise articulation on technical terms. Measured pace. Clinical but not cold. The voice of someone who takes the weight of the work seriously.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の転居先の医療情報を医療チームで引き継ぎします
lines.en: Ren, we carefully transfer patient medical records to their new care providers as a team.
lines.style: Steady, competent tone. Slight emphasis on 「carefully」. Unhurried. The reassurance of a process being done right.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、家系で病をつぐ、つまり継ぐ遺伝病を医療チームで検査します
lines.en: Ren, we screen for inherited genetic diseases that run in families—as our medical team.
lines.style: Even pace. Gentle on the word 「families」—acknowledging the human weight behind the data. Clear, not detached.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様を治療に導かれる対話を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we conduct thoughtful conversations with patients to guide them toward treatment—always as a team.
lines.style: Warmth underneath the clinical register. Slight pause before 「treatment」. Emphasis on dialogue, not direction. Steady presence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病理組織検査を医療チームで慎重におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we perform pathological tissue analysis with great care as a medical team.
lines.style: Careful articulation. Slower pace on 「pathological」 and 「tissue」. Respect for precision. The voice of someone handling something delicate.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、全土の感染症動向を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we monitor infectious disease trends nationwide with our team.
lines.style: Steady opening. Slightly lower register on 「nationwide」—acknowledging scope without alarm. Close, quiet finish. Composed watchfulness.
